 * Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Software Engineer Intern, Frontend
description:
About Houseware:

The data landscape is evolving, and at Houseware, we're leading the charge. In the modern business world, data warehouses have become the center of data gravity. Recognizing this shift, Houseware is redefining product analytics by building solutions natively on the warehouse. We eliminate the need for external SaaS vendors and enable businesses to harness the full power of their own data.

Our team comprises seasoned engineers with a track record of building SaaS products for early-stage startups. We thrive on tackling 0->1 problems, have a strong product-thinking approach, and carry a bias toward action.

The Role:

As a Software Engineering Intern, Frontend, you will be part of a lean engineering team, extremely focused on solving user problems following best engineering practices. You would be optimising to deliver the optimal user experience while improving and advocating the best engineering practices. You will learn and be expected to - take ownership of problems end to end - this would include communicating with the stakeholders, setting the right expectations, and ensuring top quality for the code & the product being shipped.

We are hell-bent on building a forward-looking product, something that constantly pushes us to think by first principles and question assumptions, building a team that is agile in adapting and ever curious. While fast-paced execution is one of the prerequisites in this role, equally important is the ability to pause and take stock of where product/engineering is heading from a long-term perspective. Your initiative is another thing that we would expect to shine through here, as you continuously navigate through ambiguous waters while working with vigor on open-ended questions - all to solve problems for and empathize with our users.

You will completely own the test-suites on the Houseware frontend from Day 0. This would involve setting up the system and identifying & writing tests for the most impactful components. You will be designing & building the system from the ground up. And set up guidelines for other engineers to follow. Eventually, we want everyone to write their tests. With time, your contribution will grow more on the product and customer use cases, while you still own and make the final decisions on testing setup & frontend stability.

This will require a lot of figuring out on the go with guidance from engineering leaders. We want you to come with that attitude. This will help you strengthen your JS, React, and typescript knowledge, and will take you pretty deep into frontend testing.

Responsibilities:


 * Set up front-end testing framework on Houseware.
 * Identify, design & implement test cases for the most impactful components & flows.
 * Set up processes & guidelines for everyone in the team to follow.
 * Own open-ended problems. Figure solutions, and implementations, and own the releases.
 * Advocate for user experience & best practices in engineering
 * Changes are inevitable in a fast-moving environment; being flexible to changes &; communicating impacts early is of great importance.
 * Last but not least, be in charge of your time, know the impact of your code, and proactively question why we are building this.
   
   

Requirements:


 * You are good at figuring out things on the go. Have an 'I can do, I will figure out' attitude.
 * You have a solid problem-solving framework.
 * You know Javascript very well.
 * You know typescript & fundamentals of React.
 * You have written a few tests in React.
 * You want to go deeper into Js, typescript & react.
 * Care about the user. Care enough to ensure things don't break for them. Care enough to ship the right thing, ship fast, early.
   
   

Nice-to-Have:


 * Some projects to show your experience with writing tests.
 * Familiarity with product analytics tools like Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar platforms.
   
   

Why Join Houseware:

We're offering the chance to be part of a vibrant, inclusive work environment, focused on innovation and growth. At Houseware, we prioritize work-life balance and the professional development of our team members. If you're passionate about data, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to influence the future of product analytics, we would love to hear from you.

How To Apply:


 * Create a new React app
 * Copy over src from here - https://github.com/tastejs/todomvc/tree/master/examples/react
 * Once you have the above app running, set a structure for tests
 * Write a plan (readme file) to write out test cases - For each component, it should include - what type of tests, and what all cases.
 * Write at least 3 tests.
 * Create a repo on Git Hub and push the above changes.
 * Include the Github repo link on your application. Or send an email to hiring@houseware.io

Confluent is pioneering a fundamentally new category of data infrastructure focused on data in motion. Have you ever found a new favorite series on Netflix, picked up groceries curbside at Walmart, or paid for something using Square? That’s the power of data in motion in action—giving organizations instant access to the massive amounts of data that is constantly flowing throughout their business. At Confluent, we’re building the foundational platform for this new paradigm of data infrastructure. Our cloud-native offering is designed to be the intelligent connective tissue enabling real-time data, from multiple sources, to constantly stream across the organization. With Confluent, organizations can create a central nervous system to innovate and win in a digital-first world.

We’re looking for self-motivated team members who crave a challenge and feel energized to roll up their sleeves and help realize Confluent’s enormous potential. Chart your own path and take healthy risks as we solve big problems together. We value having diverse teams and want you to grow as we grow—whether you’re just starting out in your career or managing a large team, you’ll be amazed at the magnitude of your impact.

The mission of the Data Science team at Confluent is to serve as the central nervous system of all things data for the company: we build analytics infrastructure, metrics, insights, and models. Our outputs enable data-driven thinking and help optimize every part of the business. There are limitless opportunities for an ambitious data scientist to make an immediate and meaningful impact within a high-growth company.

About The Role

As a Product Data Scientist at Confluent, you will be a key player in influencing the product roadmap, collaborating with Product Managers, Engineers, and Marketing stakeholders. Your focus will include data exploration, project execution, and the creation of actionable insights to drive product strategy.

What You Will Do

As a Product Data Scientist, your responsibilities will include:


 * Identify high-impact opportunities through data exploration, and execute projects by collaborating with cross-functional teams, contributing to the enhancement of product experience and adoption.
 * Define success metrics, build and maintain dashboards to monitor the health of our product, and analyze changes in company KPIs
 * Share actionable insights and recommendations with leadership at various levels, playing a pivotal role in steering product strategy
 * Design and execute A/B tests to measure the impact of product features and launches, providing insights that guide iterative improvements. Contribute to the establishment and monitoring of key product metrics.
 * Craft compelling data stories and concise data visualizations, contributing to comprehensive dashboards and reports that measure the impact of product initiatives.
 * Collaborate with other data scientists across our organization to share best practices, learn new analytical techniques, and champion an organizational culture where data is central to decision making
   
   

What We're Looking For


 * 4+ years of experience in a Product Data Science role, preferably at a software company
 * Strong proficiency in data manipulation, especially using SQL (4+ years of experience)
 * Proficiency in data visualization and building dashboards with tools such as Tableau
 * Experience and familiarity with A/B testing and experiment best practices
 * Excellent communication skills, and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
 * Exceptional problem solving skills and detail-oriented mindset
 * Bachelor or advanced degree in a quantitative discipline: computer science, engineering, statistics, economics, etc.
   
   

What Give You An Edge


 * Proficiency in Python (or R)
 * Experience in statistical modeling (e.g., clustering, regression, time series, Bayesian statistics)

title: Product Manager
description:
Role description:







We are seeking a Product Manager to play a pivotal role in our journey through the rapidly evolving landscape of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Artificial Intelligence. As AI continues to evolve at a breakneck pace, you will be at the epicenter, supporting customers working on applications that are not just cutting-edge but are defining the future.

As a Product Manager of GenAI Studio at TI AI, you will devise the strategy, develop the roadmap, and oversee the execution and launch of some of the highest-impact initiatives that are aimed at creating the world's most advanced labeling platform for GenAI development.

Your mission is critical: to imagine and build products that provide fine-tuning datasets essential for foundational model builders and any company poised to integrate AI into their workflows. It's a chance to contribute to a technological narrative unfolding right in front of us.







Responsibilities

 1. Talk to customers & leads to understand the needs of our customers.
 2. Work cross-functionally to build the roadmap and use data to drive consensus and decision-making.
 3. Define key metrics around adoption, NPS, etc. and track them to measure success.
 4. Stay abreast of the market and the competitive landscape by conducting primary and secondary research.
 5. Work with product designers to understand user behaviour and improve product usability.
 6. Collaborate with the engineering team on tech-specs and ensure that all technical decisions are taken keeping in mind all short-term and long-term tradeoffs.
 7. Work closely with Sales and Product Marketing teams on strategy & execution around distribution and pricing.




Requirements

 * At least 3-4 years of product management or founder-level experience in building highly technical or developer-facing SaaS products.
 * Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills that help you articulate customer problems precisely.
 * Persistence and resourcefulness - a whatever-it-takes approach to problem-solving and delivering great customer experiences.
 * You have an eye for great products and are able to influence business decisions with qualitative and quantitative reasoning.
 * Experience building Enterprise B2B products or games is a plus.
 * Computer Science, Math, or Engineering degree from a premier institute is a plus.




You'll catch our eye if

 1. You think in first principles.
 2. You love building new things. You show a passion for technology, have a repertoire of ideas, and have side projects to show for it.
 3. You have demonstrated leadership ability at work or through extracurricular projects.
 4. You have an insatiable curiosity that drives you to keep up with the market, to learn, and to excel.
 5. You can seamlessly zoom in on tasks in a particular sprint and zoom out to connect them to the macro trends that are shaping the market.
 6. You are technical enough to review tech-specs or write customer-facing API docs.
 7. Beyond just shipping new products, you obsess about building with quality and making the building process enjoyable for everyone you work with.

title: Associate Product Manager

title: Product Manager - Payment Services
description:
Who Are Tide

At Tide, we’re on a mission to save businesses time and money. We’re the leading provider of UK SME business accounts and one of the fastest-growing FinTechs in the UK. Using the latest tech, we design solutions with SMEs in mind and our member-driven financial platform is transforming the business banking market. Not only do we offer our members business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly connected admin tools for businesses.

Tide is about doing what you love. We’re looking for someone to join us on our exciting scale up journey and be a part of something special. We are wanting passionate Tideans to drive innovation and help build a best-in-class platform to support our members. You will be comfortable in ambiguous situations and will be able to navigate the evolving FinTech environment. Imagine shaping how millions of Tide members discover and engage with business banking platforms and building this on a global scale.

What We’re Looking For

We're looking for a brilliant Product Manager to join Tide’s payments team as we build an scalable BaaS platform internally to support products to solve the most important problems for micro, small & medium enterprises and at the same time support internalisation ambitions. We want someone that is excited to join a rapidly growing scale up and contribute in building the Banking Infrastructure that can be scalable across markets

Responsibilities

You will work directly with a development team and collaborate with your payments team members and other teams across Tide. Your responsibilities will include but not be limited to:


 * Owning the account lifecycle (open, manage & close) and ledger products within the internal BaaS platform and ensuring information is in sync with external Banking partners
 * Working closely alongside designers, developers and marketers to build and launch new account products and features and improvements to existing ones
 * Working closely with other product teams within & outside payments to collect requirements & pitch the opportunity in launching purpose driven accounts
 * Steering your development teams and defining and prioritisation of the products in detail - also working on risk mitigation with internal and external stakeholders
 * Ensuring that requirements from the different stakeholders are fully understood and met within your product scope.
 * Ensuring that other teams, such as risk and compliance, finance, operations are fully equipped to support new products and features pre- and post launch
 * Prioritising initiatives as well as well-prepared communication to stakeholders at different levels.
   
   

You’ll Be a Great Fit If


 * You love taking ownership on the products you are responsible for and have a getting things done mentality
 * You feel confident on owning your own path of success in a fast-growing company
 * You have a good understanding of technology, new-age banking trends & payments industry
 * You have at least 4 years of experience in building payment products or payment related products across the product development lifecycle from scoping to delivery. Any experience in building payment platforms is preferred
 * You have worked in a smaller, fast moving company where priorities can change and processes may need to be created from scratch
 * You have a hands on mentality, working with suppliers, and finding ways around issues as they arise.
 * You have extensively used data at every step in your last few stints to guide all your decisions making
 * You are capable of managing and prioritising various products and features at different life cycle stages - considering impact on revenue and customers.
 * You are managing different points of view and create clarity across the organisation by having a structured communication approach
   
   

What You’ll Get In Return

Make work, work for you! We are embracing new ways of working and support flexible working arrangements. With our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for 90 days of the year. Plus, you’ll get:


 * 25 days paid annual leave
 * 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
 * Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
 * Personal L&D budget in the amount of INR 40,000 per year
 * Additional health & dental insurance
 * Mental wellbeing platform
 * Food vouchers from Pluxee (Formerly Sodexo)
 * Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
 * WFH equipment allowance
 * Share options
   
   

Tidean Ways of Working

At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. Our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy allows you to work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. We are remote first, but when you do want to meet new people, collaborate with your team or simply hang out with your colleagues, our offices are always available and equipped to the highest standard. We offer flexible working hours and trust our employees to do their work well, at times that suit them and their team.

Tide is a place for everyone

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity status or disability status. We believe it’s what makes us awesome at solving problems! We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

description:

Web-based product configurators to launch in days vs. quarters

As an Associate Product Manager in the Synapse team, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative products and features that enhance user experiences and drive long-term growth for our customers. Skills


 * Analytical Thinking & Research orientation

 * Experience conducting user research and usability testing.

 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills for articulation of product requirements, effective collaboration and stakeholder management.

 * Familiarity with agile development processes and principles.
 * Technical Acumen
 * Good understanding of technology stacks and the ability to engage effectively with technical teams.
 * Knowledge of APIs and their role in modern software development.

 * Strong collaborative skills, working effectively with cross-functional teams including design, development, and QA.
 * Experience facilitating productive discussions and workshops.
   
   

Experience And Qualifications


 * Previous work experience as an Associate Product Manager / Product Manager or a similar role
 * Experience in developing modern, cloud-native mobile / web products and interfaces with contemporary UI/UX patterns
 * Software Engineering / Technical background
 * An MBA from a Tier 1 school would be a bonus
   
   

Life At Zeta

At Zeta, we want you to grow to be the best version of yourself by unlocking the great potential that lies within you. This is why our core philosophy is ‘People Must Grow.’ We recognize your aspirations; act as enablers by bringing you the right opportunities, and let you grow as you chase disruptive goals. is adventurous and exhilarating at the same time. You get to work with some of the best minds in the industry and experience a culture that values the diversity of thoughts. If you want to push boundaries, learn continuously and grow to be the best version of yourself, Zeta is the place to be!

Explore the life at zeta

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Job Title: Associate Product Manager

Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as an Associate Product Manager. The ideal candidate will have 1 to 2 years of experience in a product department and possess a strong passion for technology and innovation. As an Associate Product Manager, you will work closely with the Product Manager to develop and execute product strategies, drive product development initiatives, and ensure the successful launch of new products.

Roles And Responsibilities


 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, and sales to define product requirements and specifications.
 * Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify market trends, customer needs, and potential opportunities for product enhancements.
 * Assist in the development of product roadmaps and prioritize feature requests based on business objectives and customer feedback.
 * Participate in product development sprints, ensuring that products are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
 * Support the Product Manager in creating and maintaining product documentation, including user guides, release notes, and training materials.
 * Assist in conducting user testing and gathering feedback to validate product concepts and improve user experience.
 * Collaborate with the marketing team to develop go-to-market strategies, including pricing, positioning, and messaging.
 * Monitor product performance and analyze key metrics to identify areas for improvement and optimize product performance.
 * Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor offerings to provide insights and recommendations for product enhancements.
   
   

Qualifications


 * Bachelor's degree in Technology or a related field.
 * 1 to 2 years of experience in a product department, preferably in a technology-driven company.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
 * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
 * Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
 * Proficient in using project management and collaboration tools.
 * Knowledge of agile development methodologies is a plus.
 * Passion for technology and innovation, with a strong desire to learn and grow in the product management field.
   
   

If you are a self-driven individual with a passion for product management and a desire to make a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join our dynamic team as an Associate Product Manager.

Chennai, India

At Vendasta, we believe in helping great local businesses survive and thrive in a world that’s more competitive than ever—and we’re growing our team! We are growing and looking to onboard people who embody our core values and are excited to contribute to the world-class work we do here at Vendasta.

Keep reading if you’d like to join us on our mission to support small businesses all over the world.

About The Job

Are you passionate about solving important problems? Are you inspired by the opportunity to help local businesses thrive? Do you enjoy collaboratively crafting and executing on long-term strategies? Vendasta Technologies is seeking someone just like you to fill our role of Product Manager.

As a Vendasta Product Manager, you will guide the strategy and execution for the vision “Build on the Vendasta Platform”. You will use data to identify and prioritize high-impact work by collaborating with cross-functional teams, gathering insights from users and other stakeholders, and testing prototypes and features. Working with the leadership team, software developers, design and product marketing, you will build innovative and customer-focused products / Integrations to Vendasta platform for our channel partners and small-to-medium-sized businesses they serve. This is an incredible career opportunity to join an innovative and high-growth company to build products that empower our channel partners to acquire, retain, and grow their client base—all the way from researching leads to fulfilling digital solutions. You will build products from existing ideas and help to develop new ideas based on your industry experience, as well as your contact with stakeholders, customers, and prospects. You must possess a unique blend of business and technical savvy, ability to create and communicate a big-picture vision, and the drive to make that vision a reality.

Your Impact


 * Own, manage, and deliver the vision, strategy, and execution of a Vendasta product and Integrations with Channel Partners.
 * Drive the roadmap and prioritization of innovative and engaging features that solve our customers’ biggest problems
 * Guide a custom product for Integration, launch, measurement of success, and ongoing iteration alongside a skilled and passionate cross-functional team.
 * Collaborate and communicate frequently with key stakeholders—including users, channel partners, sales, support, and the leadership team—to gather important insights that drive your product in the right direction
 * Develop measurable objectives, track and measure user activity, learn and iterate quickly.
 * Measure success against objectives and business outcomes, not just feature delivery.
 * Facilitate weekly business reviews and product backlog refinement sessions with development teams and stakeholders, to continually measure, learn and iterate your product towards meeting objectives.
 * Prioritize and allocate resources against a variety of ongoing projects and releases across your cross-functional teams
 * Define the problem and scope for a given epic and present backlog items and key milestones to make up product roadmap
 * Work with development teams to ensure software is built according to the acceptance criteria and our software development principles.
 * Define the problem and scope for a given epic and present backlog items and key milestones to make up the product roadmap
 * Actively engage with your scrum team to ensure development decisions stay aligned with user and business needs
 * Develop expertise in your focus area, and keep on top of competitors and industry trends
 * Be the subject matter specialist and evangelist for your product; educating stakeholders on new features and value proposition
   
   

What You Bring To The Table


 * 4+ years as a Product Manager
 * B2B Saas Experience is considered as an asset
 * Empathy—this means you'll have the ability and desire to deeply understand our customers; what motivates them, frustrates them and makes them happy.
 * Proven leadership capabilities and ability to motivate and unify multiple cross-functional teams to work towards a common goal
 * Strong communication skills—written and via presentation to an audience.
 * Innovative and consistently curious—constantly seeking ways to improve our offerings based on industry trends, experience, common customer pain points, and competitor research
 * Knowledgeable about and up-to-date on technology—especially in the Software as a Service (SaaS) space; interested in learning about what other companies are doing and finding ways to apply to our offerings
 * Demonstrated success in delivering innovative and user-friendly products from inception to delivery
 * Exceptional problem-solving capabilities that prioritize across multiple key stakeholders, as well as internal teams
 * Ability to make confident recommendations based on data analysis, customer insight and ongoing stakeholder engagement
 * Previous experience working in a scrum/agile environment.
 * Experience writing product requirements, user stories and functional specifications for both technical and non-technical audiences.
 * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or an applicable field is considered a strong asset
   
   

About Vendasta

So what do we actually do? We create an entire platform full of digital products & solutions that help small to medium sized businesses (SMBs) have a stronger presence online through digital advertising, online listings, reputation management, website creation, social media marketing … and much more! Our platform is used exclusively by channel partners, who sell products and services to SMBs, allowing them to leverage us to scale and grow their business. We’re trusted by 65,000+ channel partners, serving over 5.5 million small to medium businesses worldwide!

As we progress on this journey, finance plays a critical partnership role to ensure we deliver an effective transformation by steering project expenditure away from our Operating Companies “OpCo’s” and towards our central departments so that this cost is operationally and financially in line with WPP IT’s strategic goals.




You will lead on the validation and analysis of the baseline volumes, especially the changes in them created by the WPP business over time which culminates in the monthly variable charging element of the new outsourced “Kepler” contract which covers WPP’s Infrastructure, Network, Security and Digital Workplace services globally.

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Analyst to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in analyzing financial data, conducting research, and providing insights to support decision-making processes within the organization.




Responsibilities




 * Financial Analysis: Conduct in-depth financial analysis to evaluate investment opportunities, assess risks, and identify potential returns.
 * Market Research: Stay up-to-date with financial markets, industry trends, and economic developments to provide relevant insights and recommendations.
 * Data Analysis: Gather, clean, and analyze large datasets to extract meaningful insights and trends, using tools like Excel, SQL, or specialized financial software.
 * Report Generation: Prepare reports and presentations summarizing financial analysis findings and present them to senior management or clients as required.
 * Modeling: Develop financial models to forecast investment outcomes, perform scenario analysis, and assess various investment strategies.
 * Risk Assessment: Identify and assess potential risks associated with investment opportunities and provide risk mitigation strategies.
 * Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including portfolio managers, traders, and compliance, to ensure effective communication and execution of investment strategies.
 * Compliance: Ensure that all financial analysis and investment activities comply with regulatory guidelines and internal policies.




Requirements




 * Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, or a related field (Master's degree or CFA designation is a plus).
 * Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
 * Proficiency in financial modeling and data analysis tools.
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 * Attention to detail and ability to work under pressure.
 * Strong problem-solving abilities.
 * Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
 * Prior experience in financial analysis or a related field is preferred but not required.
 * Knowledge of financial markets and investment strategies is a plus.




This job was posted by Anjali C from Redrock Capital Advisors.

After our successful Series D in 2021, we raised another $50M last year, doubling our valuation to $12B.

Responsibilities:

We are looking for a proactive Junior Finance Analyst with a strong data orientation to contribute to our financial analysis and reporting processes. Your responsibilities will encompass:


 * Data-Driven Insights: Extracting actionable insights from extensive and intricate data sets, enabling informed decision-making.
 * Workflow Development: Creating efficient data processing workflows to enhance our reporting capabilities and streamline data accessibility.

 * SQL Proficiency: Fluent in SQL for efficient data querying and manipulation.

 * Financial Acumen: Solid understanding of P&L and Cash-Flow concepts.

 * Educational Background: Preferred, minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, or a related field. A Master's degree is preferred.
   
   
   

This role presents an exciting opportunity for a budding finance professional with a strong inclination towards data-driven analysis and reporting.

title: Features Writer, Vogue
description:
The foundation of Vogue’s leadership and authority is the brand’s unique role as a cultural barometer for a global audience. Vogue places fashion in the context of culture and the world we live in — how we dress, live and socialize; what we eat, listen to and watch; who leads and inspires us. Vogue immerses itself in fashion, always leading readers to what will happen next. Thought-provoking, relevant and always influential, Vogue defines the culture of fashion.

Job Description

Location:

Mumbai, MH

Position Summary & Scope:

As a features writer at Vogue India, you will play a vital role in producing engaging, curated and well-written fashion and culture features for the website. Working closely with the fashion and features editors, you will contribute to the creation of captivating stories that align with Vogue's brand identity and cater to the Indian and global markets.

Experience:

2-4 years

Areas of Responsibility (Key Result Areas):

Trend spotting - Keep abreast of all fashion and pop culture news and tailor features to respond accordingly. Remember, before it's in fashion, it's in Vogue, so in-depth knowledge about fashion is a prerequisite.

Producing quality features - Produce well-researched, engaging and original features, interviews and opinion pieces that align with Vogue India's style, tone and editorial guidelines. It is crucial to have an ear to the ground at all times so you're able to present one-of-a-kind stories that haven't been told before.

Fact Checking - Verify the accuracy, credibility and authenticity of information and sources used in the features articles.

Adhering to deadlines and quick turnaround - In the fast-paced universe of Condé Nast, content is king but timing is queen. As part of the leading fashion publication in the world, you will need to ensure that feature targets for fashion and culture pieces are always met.

Collaboration - Collaborate with Photographers, Stylists, Writers and other creatives to bring a new perspective to fashion and culture content.

Liaising with contributing writers - This involves writing to and compiling pitches from Vogue India's fashion and feature contributors and running them by the respective section editors to create a monthly calendar.

Networking - Attend fashion shows, events, and industry gatherings to build relationships with key stakeholders, gather industry insights, and source potential feature opportunities.

Ideating for social media - One of the key responsibilities of your job is to ideate on how to tell stories for social media. Social is a constantly evolving behemoth and with the proliferation of apps, it is crucial for you to have a sound understanding of the landscape in order to adapt content for each platform.

Ideating for video content - Vogue has seen great results in its thrust towards video content and our video strategy is something we will continue to refine and solidify over the course of the next few months. As a features writer, you will play an integral part in shaping Vogue India's video future.

Reporting To:

Features Editor and Senior Features Editor

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

description:
Job Description Summary:




 * Plan, conduct and monitor quality of a product line including incoming, in-process and final inspection of parts and shall be accountable for on-time inspection of parts to meet the customer demand with almost focus on quality objectives.







Job Description

 * Approve in-process production by confirming required specifications, conducting visual and measurement tests, and communicating the required adjustments to the production supervisor
 * Preferred coming from a Heavy Fabrication industry with knowledge of welding & fabrication activities from the Quality perspective shall be well versed in MIG/MAG, GTAW, & SMAW process
 * Approve all finished products by confirming specifications and conducting required tests
 * Document and update inspection results by completing reports and logs
 * Investigate customer complaints and non-conformance issues
 * Develop, recommend and monitor corrective and preventive actions
 * Responsible for Driving Quality in products and processes and establishing process for ensuring meeting the Customer expectations
 * Responsible for collect and compile statistical quality data
 * Document internal audits and other quality assurance activities
 * Evaluate audit findings and implement appropriate corrective actions
 * Marinate reports to communicate outcomes of quality activities
 * Proactively identifying areas of obstruction / breakdowns and take steps to rectify the problem at early stage
 * Assist Manufacturing in investigations of process related quality issues
 * Tracking and controlling the rejection by raising alarm/ NC with immediate effect and maintaining CoQ as per organizational requirements
 * Involved in Kaizen and other process improvements like suggestion activities
 * Proficient in computer skills, including MS Office
 * Calibration activity of all Measuring and testing instruments at in-house and sub-contracting.
 * Manage MRB & RTV and ensure on-time disposition / drive supplier recovery as applicable; also maintain critical supplier score card
 * Participate in HPT Team discussions (HPT = High Performance Teams) and provide insights on quality, quality escapes and issue resolution, RCA, CAPA etc.
 * Shall be familiar with manufacturing processes including assembly, torqueing, wiring harness assembly, electronic component handling etc
 * Shall be responsible for total compliance to Quality Management System and Lead key initiatives; align the function with business goals to support 2x growth of the business Year-Over-Year
 * Use experience and expertise to perform the assigned tasks himself and provide leadership to quality inspectors, mentor & train them and ensure their skill enhancement continuously.
 * Own Quality Metrics including COQ, FPY, DPU, Escaping Defects, Customer Issue Resolution, On-Time Qualification etc. for the product line
 * Work closely with AME Team to manage digitization of key quality metrics, deployment of Quality module in MES etc. and also support Lean initiatives (re-layout/ resource optimization/ automation etc.)
 * Calibration Management of all gauges / instruments / fixtures; deploy smart gauges (blue tooth enabled) to help accelerate digitization of manufacturing operations




Qualification & Essential Requirements:

 * Education: Diploma in in Mechanical or Production Engineering from a reputed college /university
 * 3 - 4 years hands on experience in Quality, Preferred NDT.
 * Shall be willing to work in shifts to meet the organizational goals.
 * Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate across levels
 * The candidate shall be highly energetic and passionate with positive attitude. He shall be able to explain clearly business drivers and organizational objectives to team.




 * Desired Characteristics:
 * Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn
 * Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively
 * Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed
 * Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative
 * Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker
 * Ability to handle diverse activities simultaneously. Knowledge of 5S, Lean and Six Sigma Methodology.
